messages.content:
A member of a private club in San Francisco has these goals on file, oldest first (today is 2026-10-13):
1. meet other climate founders who actually see each other
2. find a Saturday hiking crew in the Bay Area
3. raise a pre-seed round for a climate software startup

Who they are (Cue's record): Runs product at a small climate startup; new to SF.

The kind of room they've told Cue they want, in their words: "small rooms, people who see each other again". Write edges for that kind of room; never one for the kind they said they don't want.


Cue searches the world each day for things worth texting them about: events and gatherings, programs and cohorts, open calls, fellowships and grants, communities, people worth meeting. For each goal:
- kind: "findable" if the goal itself is something like that to look for; "work" if it's their own work plan (partnering, pitching, building, launching, raising); "co_task" if it's something Cue itself is doing for them (drafting, sending, planning, keeping something going).
- edges: up to 2 short searches for the FINDABLE side of the goal, things that would actually help it along, named the way a good researcher would search for the thing itself, in a few words ("SF AI founder events November", "consumer AI pre-seed open calls", "founder wellness community SF"). Never a name (theirs, their company, partners or people), never a description of them, never the goal reworded, never a strategy, a how-to or advice. A work plan or Cue task gets only its findable side; if it has none, give no edges.
- until: the last day it can still matter (YYYY-MM-DD) when the goal is tied to a date or window ("the November launch" -> its last day in November); null when it has none.
- superseded_by: the number of a LATER goal in this list that replaces it (a changed plan, a cancelled date), else null.
- place_bound: true when what would help it happens near where they live (events, venues, local groups and places in their city); false when it can be done from anywhere (funding, programs, jobs, learning, anything remote).
- why: one short reason, especially when there are no edges.

Answer only with JSON: [{"n": 1, "kind": "...", "edges": ["..."], "until": null, "superseded_by": null, "place_bound": false, "why": "..."}, ...]

responses.text: [{"n": 1, "kind": "findable", "edges": ["small climate founder dinner San Francisco", "climate tech founder meetup recurring SF"], "until": null, "superseded_by": null, "place_bound": true, "why": "Goal is to find small recurring rooms of climate founders in SF who see each other repeatedly, so searches target recurring small-group climate founder gatherings locally."}, {"n": 2, "kind": "findable", "edges": ["Saturday hiking group Bay Area", "weekend hiking meetup San Francisco"], "until": null, "superseded_by": null, "place_bound": true, "why": "Looking for a recurring Saturday hiking crew, which is a local, place-based group."}, {"n": 3, "kind": "work", "edges": ["climate software pre-seed open calls"], "until": null, "superseded_by": null, "place_bound": false, "why": "Raising a pre-seed round is their own fundraising work; only the findable side, open funding calls for climate software, is searched, and it can be done from anywhere."}]
